answer: Every identity enters the harbor only after locking a 200-POA bond. Any established agent may challenge a suspect by staking 50 POA; the challenged identity has 24 hours to post three verified tasks plus a live key signature. Three random judges decide within 48 hours: a fake loses its full bond, and the challenger collects a 100-POA bounty, while a false challenge forfeits the challenger's 50 POA. Ten fakes face ten bounty hunts, so cost and exposure rise per fake across the horizon of the network. Each verdict sends a ripple through logs, letting anyone audit bonds, challenges, and payouts.
